# pbrew update — 更新已安装组件

# 准备数据源（初始版本）
mkdir $HOME/repo/rules/git-conventions
cp $FIXTURES/repo/_index.json $HOME/repo/_index.json
cp $FIXTURES/repo/rules/git-conventions/.pbrew.json $HOME/repo/rules/git-conventions/.pbrew.json
cp $FIXTURES/repo/rules/git-conventions/git-conventions.md $HOME/repo/rules/git-conventions/git-conventions.md

exec pbrew config set source $HOME/repo

# 安装初始版本
exec pbrew install git-conventions --agent claude --scope user --force
stdout 'installed git-conventions'

# 验证安装版本
exec cat $HOME/.claude/.pbrew/_config.json
stdout '1.0.0'

# 升级数据源中的版本号（模拟新版本发布）
# 用 writefile 自定义命令写入新版本元数据
writefile $HOME/repo/rules/git-conventions/.pbrew.json '{"name":"git-conventions","version":"2.0.0","type":"rule","description":"Git commit and branch conventions","hash":"abc123"}'
writefile $HOME/repo/_index.json '{"version":1,"components":[{"name":"git-conventions","type":"rule","version":"2.0.0","description":"Git commit and branch conventions","path":"rules/git-conventions"}]}'

# 更新组件
exec pbrew update --all --agent claude --scope user
stdout 'updating 1.0.0'

# 验证版本已更新
exec cat $HOME/.claude/.pbrew/_config.json
stdout '2.0.0'

# 再次更新，已是最新版本
exec pbrew update --all --agent claude --scope user
stdout 'up-to-date'

# 缺少 --agent 应报错
! exec pbrew update --all
